tasks.short: Maintain awareness of zoning and growth.

steps.what: Note growth possibilities of the property.

tasks.design: The broker maintains awareness of income regulations, building regulations, and growth possibilities. {DOCS} only opens the zoning note they last stored. Nothing states the law for them.
tasks.previous_blocker: The zoning note was filed where they could not find it.
tasks.enabler_now: A zoning note they already wrote can be opened.
tasks.still_hard: What the rules mean for this property stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker maintains the awareness. An opened note does not.
tasks.altitude: The awareness stays in full. Only opening the stored zoning note is shorter.

reach.task: Hear growth possibilities the broker noted
reach.learn: The broker still reads the current rule

evidence.claim: A stored zoning note can be opened again. It does not state today's rule. The broker maintains that awareness.
National rules differ on who may advise a buyer about a price or a mortgage. A system does not give that advice here. The broker does.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the broker prepares on a property's area and ends when they have noted the growth possibilities. Nothing is published.
The fields are the zone name and the date of the note. The broker produces the note. If it is missing, they read the source.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the awareness stays.
unknowns: Whether a zoning note for this area is already stored.
Which tax rules the office expects the broker to watch.
research_questions: Is a zoning note for this area already stored?
Which tax rules does the office expect the broker to watch?

tasks.short: Give buyers virtual tours of properties.

steps.what: Give buyers virtual tours of the properties.
Answer buyers interested in the tours.
Note properties the buyers stay interested in.

tasks.design: The broker gives the virtual tours and answers the buyers. {CRM} only opens the properties they named, using the photos already stored. Nothing restyles a photo and nothing generates one. An edited photo of a real home would have to be labelled. This design does not edit one.
tasks.previous_blocker: The properties were searched again at the start of each tour.
tasks.enabler_now: A property the buyer named can be opened with the photo already on file.
tasks.still_hard: What the buyer should notice on the tour stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker gives the tour. An opened photo does not.
tasks.altitude: The tours and the answers stay in full. Only opening the named properties is shorter.

reach.task: Take the tour the broker gives
reach.learn: The photos are the ones already stored

evidence.claim: Funda virtuele styler restyles listing photos. This design does not restyle a photo and does not generate a new one.

A house valuation is not credit scoring. A bot must say it is a machine. An edited photo of a real home must be labelled. Staff who use such tools need literacy. This design has no bot and does not edit photos.
In August 2026 many edited photos of real homes were still online, and the site acted when people reported them.
Recording calls, or analysing speech in a way that can monitor staff, needs works-council consent. This design does not record a call or a seminar and does not score the broker.

assumptions: The workflow starts when buyers name properties and ends when the broker has noted which ones they stay interested in. The broker gives the tour. No photo is edited. The tour is not recorded.
The fields are property id and the photo file already stored. The listing produces the photo. The broker produces the note of interest. If there is no photo, the broker does not invent one.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the tour stays.
unknowns: Whether the stored photo is the unedited one.
Whether the buyer wants a visit because the screen is not enough.
research_questions: Is the stored photo the unedited one?
Does the buyer want a visit because the screen is not enough?

tasks.short: Arrange title searches and explain the result.

steps.what: Read the address of the properties.
Accept the title searches they arrange.
Read the title searches that return.
Explain the title searches to the parties.

tasks.design: The broker accepts the search for the address on file. {GOV_PORTAL} sends that request. The broker then reads what returns and explains it. The send is the request, not an opinion. The broker does not issue a policy.
tasks.previous_blocker: The address was retyped into the registry each time.
tasks.enabler_now: The property address can be sent as a search request.
tasks.still_hard: What the result means for the parties stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker reads the result. A portal does not explain it.
tasks.altitude: Accepting the request, reading the result, and explaining it stay in full. Only reading the stored address and sending the accepted request are shorter.

reach.task: Hear what the title search shows

evidence.claim: A property address can be sent as a title search request. The result still has to be read. Sending the request does not explain the title.
Identity and financial details of an owner or a buyer are personal data. They leave the office only in a version the broker has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a property is being sold and ends when the broker has explained the search. The portal sends only the accepted request.

The fields are the property address and a title reference if one is already known. The file produces the address. The registry produces the result. If the portal rejects the request, the broker sends it by hand. They do not issue a policy.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the reading and the explanation stay.
unknowns: Whether the registry portal accepts a request from the broker.
Whether a title reference is already on the file.
research_questions: Does the registry portal accept a request from the broker?
Is a title reference already on the file?

tasks.short: Manage the offices and file the accepted details.

steps.what: Operate the offices, handling associated details.

tasks.design: The broker manages and operates the offices. {ERP} only lists business details still open. They accept the details. {DOCS} files that version. Nothing manages the office.
tasks.previous_blocker: Open details were kept in a book the rest of the office could not see.
tasks.enabler_now: An office record can list a detail that is still open.
tasks.still_hard: How the office is run stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker manages the office. A list does not.
tasks.altitude: Managing and operating the offices stay in full. Only the list of open details and the filing of the accepted details are shorter.

reach.task: See the business details the broker accepted
reach.learn: The broker still runs the office

evidence.claim: A list of open office details can be filed after the person who runs the office accepts it. The list does not run the office.
Recording calls, or analysing speech in a way that can monitor staff, needs works-council consent. This design does not record a call or a seminar and does not score the broker.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the office has open business details and ends when the accepted details are on file. The broker manages and operates the office. Staff are not scored and calls are not recorded.
The fields are the detail name, the owner of the detail, and the status open or done. The broker produces the status. If a detail is not in the list, they add it before accepting.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the management stays.
unknowns: Whether open business details are already a list.
Which details the broker treats as theirs rather than a bookkeeper's.
